in_hebrew.name: Waylan
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Waylan הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English 'wealh' meaning 'foreigner' or 'stranger', and 'lan' meaning 'land'. The name Waylan can be interpreted as a 'traveler from a foreign land'. This name has a strong connection to spiritual journeys and personal growth.
